_comment: One profile matrix for every platform. The launchers (bash on Linux/macOS,
PowerShell on Windows) both read this file; nobody hard-codes switches.
Selection: the first profile whose match.os and match.vendor apply, with
optional vram_min_mb / vram_max_mb bounds. Later profiles are fallbacks.
Every number here was measured or taken from a test report; see docs/FORK.md,
and do not add a value that has not been measured on that platform.

profiles.name: linux-amd-16gb
profiles.note: RX 9070 XT, Mesa 26.3.1. 512 MB card buffers: median 0.60-0.70 fps, 10th percentile 0.30-0.40 vs 0.10 at 1024 (two sweeps, 0 removals) - the steadiest configuration measured. Do not raise LATE_WAIT: 3 removes the device. Texture budget 4096 MB: texture phase 350 -> 40-48 ms, frame 1,464-1,976 -> 1,046-1,182 ms, median 0.80-1.00 (two runs, no removals). Section views on by default under Wine (code, not a variable): one mapping per section, view unmaps 44,000 -> 0, frame 1,203-1,448 -> 750-952 ms, median 0.80 -> 1.10-1.30 across three runs each. Indirect window + runs on (from #8/#9, AST/steve ports of fxceless): two quick runs each 3.95 fps / 255-259 ms against 3.05-3.25 default, p10 3.30, no removals. VICTORY_INDIRECT_WINDOW=0 or RUNS=0 if a long session ever loses the device. Card hash lanes on (from #11, astrosteveo): GPU phase 88-110 -> 31.7 ms, frame 226 -> 150 ms, median 4.45 -> 6.60/6.70 across two runs, no removals; NVIDIA measured 5.25-5.30 vs 4.40-4.65 by the author. VICTORY_CARD_HASH_LANES=0 turns it off.

profiles.name: linux-other
profiles.note: Intel/other Vulkan drivers: mesh shaders and SM 6.6 required. Report results, then promote to a measured profile.

profiles.name: windows-amd
profiles.note: README combo. If the Adrenalin DXIL compiler crashes (amdxc64.dll), add VICTORY_SHADER_OPT=59 (issue #422) and the RDNA4 skips from issue #3.

profiles.name: windows-nvidia
profiles.note: Fork README: RELAY=2 or the late-wait combo. Issue #417 (RTX 5070 Ti) reports 3.9-4.2 fps.

profiles.name: windows-other
profiles.note: Requires a D3D12 GPU with SM 6.6 and mesh shaders.

overrides.name: safe
overrides.note: No submissions ahead of the fence. Slowest, most stable. Use it when a run dies with 'device removed'.

overrides.name: diagnostics
overrides.note: Verbose GPU logging for bug reports.
